calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of the prior three-session return, amplified by the prior session's volume surprise versus its trailing 20-session mean. All inputs are lagged one completed session relative to the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Rejected by the benchmark-wide same-horizon daily admission gate on the current 2026 validation slice: daily IC and ICIR are both below threshold. Longer-horizon results are not substituted for the required daily gate; low 18.6% coverage also limits confidence.
